summary: Athena Technology Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K reporting a monthly deposit of $271.48 into its trust account to extend its deadline to complete an initial business combination by one month, from July 14, 2026 to August 14, 2026. This is the second of up to nine permitted monthly extensions under its charter. No target, price, premium, or advisor is named. The filing is a routine SPAC extension, reflecting ongoing search efforts and preservation of the trust. Key watchpoint: risk of liquidation if no business combination is consummated before the final extension date.
